proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged the sharp worst-menu fixed-table regret order min{1,sqrt(K log K/n)} using a feasible CVZ experiment and an all-procedure cyclic-menu converse. Math and decision referees passed and every cited logical claim was attested, but D0.5 assigned incremental after its paper-score cap, below the mandatory field floor; no bounded repair in the admitted scope raises the tier. tldr: A single matching experiment must choose among \(K\) public assignment plans for fixed worker and job populations. The focal object is the worst-menu minimax expected loss in complete realized plan value. The research question asks for its explicit order uniformly over \(2\le K\le n\), a finitely realizable attaining experiment for every overlapping menu, and a matching converse covering every outcome-blind assignment and every original-record selector. Existing dependent rounding supplies the feasible concentration upper. The proposed contribution is the unrestricted fixed-table logarithmic converse and its small-menu completion, with the rate and boundary regimes certified in the original decision problem.
gap: Wang studies precision for two fixed matching plans. CVZ already supplies feasible concentration for nonnegative matching scores. Fixed-array best-arm identification already uses realized hindsight values. These results do not by themselves certify the uniform all-design matching-menu simple-regret frontier.
fill: A full-record information calculation and a posterior decision identity connect feasible sampling to realized plan regret. Their assembly with inherited rounding must deliver matching universal-factor certificates through all menu-size and population-size boundaries.
